body:
Please review the experimental (EXP) annotations to the following regulation terms, which have been proposed for obsoletion:

- [GO:1903747](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:1903747) regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion
- [GO:1903748](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:1903748) negative regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion
- [GO:1903749](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:1903749) positive regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion

## Context

Per the mitochondrial import reorganization effort (geneontology/go-ontology#31711) and the obsoletion request in geneontology/go-ontology#32107, these three regulation terms have been flagged for obsoletion:

- They represent phenotypes rather than distinct biological processes, and/or were added in error.
- Per the parent ticket: \"The 59 EXP (27 HTP) to these regulation terms are mainly mitophagy or chaperones. All can be annotated to other more appropriate terms.\"

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here (with AI generated recommendations):
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dh2DfWzw57wm6RdzJwHwX_bbyWqb9BkaTiHXnogd3JA

Annotations by:
ParkinsonsUK-UCL	46 - done
UniProt	6
MGI	6
RGD	5
FlyBase	3
Reactome	4
UOS_MCB	2

Mappings that need to be reviewed:
GO:1903749	reactome2go	Reactome:R-HSA-114452 > GO:positive regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion ; GO:1903749
GO:1903749	reactome2go	Reactome:R-HSA-75108 > GO:positive regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion ; GO:1903749

## Requested action

Curators from impacted groups are asked to review each EXP annotation and re-annotate to a more appropriate term. Suggested replacements:

- Regulation of the actual process being regulated (e.g., regulation of mitophagy, regulation of a specific mitochondrial protein import pathway).
- If the underlying evidence is a readout, a phenotype, or the mechanism is unclear (especially for HTP data), consider removal.

For the specific mitochondrial protein import pathway terms now available, see the reorganization in geneontology/go-ontology#31711.

## Tracking

- Ontology obsoletion ticket: geneontology/go-ontology#32107
- Parent reorganization ticket: geneontology/go-ontology#31711

author: mlkaldunski
body:
May I respectfully point out that these terms were given as replacement terms in ticket issue 6065 last December. 
GO:1903214 regulation of protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:1903747 regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:1903955 positive regulation of protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:1903749 positive regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:1903215 negative regulation of protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:1903748 negative regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion
We updated the annotations at that time, and now you are obsoleting these terms as well. This means someone at RGD has had to touch each of these papers at least 3 times.
Maybe would it be possible to use AI and search tickets for terms that have been given as replacement terms and seriously consider NOT deleting/obsoleting them? This isn't the first time this combination of events has happened, and it is very frustrating.
'
